_instructions.how_to_add_item: Copy any item block inside a category's 'items' array. Change name, price, description, and image. Save the file — the website updates automatically.
_instructions.how_to_change_price: Find the item by its 'name', change the 'price' value. Use the ৳ symbol before the number, e.g. '৳350'.
_instructions.how_to_add_category: Add a new object to the 'categories' array. Give it a unique 'id' (lowercase, no spaces), a 'label' (shown on the tab), and an 'items' array.
_instructions.image_tip: Use any direct image URL. Unsplash URLs work great: https://images.unsplash.com/photo-XXXX?auto=format&fit=crop&w=150&q=80
